title: fsl_rigid_register
description: A front-end tool for FSL's FLIRT that computes a rigid registration matrix and resamples the input volume to the reference volume.

fslmat.description: Specifies explicitly where to store the FSL registration matrix.
fslmat.title: FSL Matrix File

regmat.description: Get registration matrix in register.dat file format.
regmat.title: Register Matrix File

xfmmat.description: Get registration matrix as MNI xfm file.
xfmmat.title: MNI XFM File

ltamat.description: Get registration matrix as MGH lta file.
ltamat.title: MGH LTA File

noinitgeom.description: Do not initialize matrix based on geometry.
noinitgeom.title: No Initial Geometry Flag

applyxfm.description: Apply a transformation file to the input without registration.
applyxfm.title: Apply Transformation File

applyinitxfm.description: Apply initial transformation to the input without registration.
applyinitxfm.title: Apply Initial Transformation Flag

initxfm.description: Use this as an initial matrix for registration.
initxfm.title: Initial Transformation File

maxangle.description: Only search over +/- max angle degrees.
maxangle.title: Max Angle

dof.description: Use degrees of freedom instead of 6.
dof.title: Degrees of Freedom

cost.description: Objective function: mutualinfo, corratio (default), normcorr, normmi, leastsq.
cost.title: Objective Function

subject.description: Only puts it in the register.dat file.
subject.title: Subject
